title: News from JMonkeyEngine - 23 January 2022
content:
Thank you for your generous contributions to our open-source software project!

We're proud to announce general availability of JMonkeyEngine 3.5.0-stable, the newest release of our game engine. Here's a link to the forum announcement:

https://hub.jmonkeyengine.org/t/next-release-of-the-engine/44988/214
